name: Saga Pattern (Orchestrator Topology)
forces_resolved: Coordinates distributed multi-service transactions without blocking 2PC locks
Central orchestrator clearly defines execution order and compensating transactions
Explicit visibility into transaction progress, timeout, and rollback state
forces_unresolved: Risk of concentrating too much business logic into the orchestrator (God service)
Compensating transactions require semantic reversal logic for every failure step
Isolation anomaly risk (dirty reads possible between local transactions)
applicability_conditions: E-commerce order checkout spanning Order, Payment, Inventory, and Delivery microservices
Multi-step booking workflows (Flight + Hotel + Rental Car)
Workflows requiring compensating actions when downstream steps fail
anti_requisites: Strict immediate isolation preventing dirty reads of uncommitted intermediary states
Single database systems (use standard ACID transactions instead)
